content: Move the REST handlers for orders and payments from src/api/v1 to src/api/v2 with typed responses (see src/api/v2/types.ts and openapi.yaml). Keep the v1 routes working through thin adapters.

  schemas:
    OrderDto:
      type: object

        status: {type: string}
        totalCents: {type: integer}
        createdAt: {type: string, format: date-time}
